'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[26 August 2024 Russian strikes on Ukraine]]
****Massive [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] attacks are launched on [[list of cities in Ukraine|cities]] across [[Ukraine]], killing at least seven people. Ukrainian officials call it the largest [[Russia]]n attack on Ukraine since the beginning of the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/explosions-in-kyiv-russia-launches-massive-missile-and-drone-attack-on-cities-across-ukraine/ (''Kyiv Independent'')] [https://kyivindependent.com/a-near-death-feeling-largest-yet-russian-attack-on-ukraines-energy-infrastructure-brings-back-widespread-power-outages/ (''Kyiv Independent 2'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-launches-drone-attack-kyiv-ukraines-military-says-2024-08-26/ (Reuters)]
****[[Poland]] says that a Russian [[Shahed drones|Shahed drone]] had likely entered its [[airspace]] during the attacks on Ukraine and that searches are underway for the object as it may have landed in Polish territory around 30 kilometers (18 miles) from the [[Poland–Ukraine border]]. [https://www.thedefensepost.com/2024/08/27/poland-shahed-drone-airspace/ (''The Defense Post'')] [https://www.rferl.org/a/poland-russian-drone-airspace-ukraine/33093125.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-army-says-object-entered-poland-during-russian-attack-ukraine-2024-08-26/ (Reuters)]
****A [[Ukrainian Air Force|Ukrainian]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]] [[fighter aircraft|fighter jet]] crashes after shooting down several [[missile]]s fired from Russia, killing the pilot. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/29/europe/ukraine-f16-crashes-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Corruption in Ukraine]]
***Audits conducted by the Ukrainian [[Ministry of Defence (Ukraine)|Ministry of Defense]] determine that between March and July, multiple [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]] units never received nearly [[United States dollar|US$]]4.2 million in military aid labeled as "humanitarian aid" to bypass customs fees, prompting [[embezzlement]] and [[illicit enrichment]] investigations. [https://kyivindependent.com/military-units-have-not-received-humanitarian-aid-worth-over-4-million-due-to-alleged-customs-violations-dm-says/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[Operation Hereof]]
***The [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] (BLA) launches an [[offensive (military)|offensive]] against the [[Pakistani Army]] in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]], gaining control of several key [[highway]]s, including the [[Karachi]]–[[Quetta]] section of [[National Highways of Pakistan|National Highway]] 8, and also damages a train station in [[Mastung District|Mastung]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/26/at-least-38-killed-in-multiple-armed-attacks-in-pakistans-balochistan (Al Jazeera)]
***At least 14 soldiers and policemen and 21 BLA gunmen are killed in [[ambush]]es and clashes on highways in Balochistan. Five civilians are also killed in [[Kalat District|Kalat]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/26/at-least-38-killed-in-multiple-armed-attacks-in-pakistans-balochistan (Al Jazeera)]
***Twenty-three people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] targeting [[Punjabis]] on a [[highway]] in [[Musakhail District]]. Between 30 and 40 armed men offloaded passengers from trucks and buses and shot them after checking their identities, subsequently [[arson|setting fire to]] their vehicles. The BLA claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1854830 (''Dawn'')] [https://www.npr.org/2024/08/26/g-s1-19547/gunmen-attacks-southwestern-pakistan (NPR)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] shell an [[internally displaced person]]s camp in [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], killing 25 people and wounding at least 40 others. [https://sudantribune.com/article290027/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**IDF launches airstrikes on Hezbollah targets in [[Kfar Kila]], [[Tayr Harfa]], [[Shebaa]] and [[Aita ash-Shaab]] and [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] of [[Chamaa]] and [[Naqoura]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/pg/photo-gallery/israel-launched-drone-strike-on-vehicle-in-southern-lebanon (Anadolu Ajansi)]
**A Hezbollah militant survives an Israeli drone strike in [[Sidon]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/pg/photo-gallery/israel-launched-drone-strike-on-vehicle-in-southern-lebanon (Anadolu Ajansi)]
**Hezbollah launches three drone strike on IDF surveillance equipment in [[Ramya]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/pg/photo-gallery/israel-launched-drone-strike-on-vehicle-in-southern-lebanon (Anadolu Ajansi)]
*[[Libyan crisis (2011–present)|Libyan crisis]]
**The [[Benghazi]]-based [[Libya]]n [[Government of National Stability]] says that it is suspending production at all [[oil field]]s and [[oil terminal]]s that it controls until further notice amid a dispute with the [[Central Bank of Libya|central bank]] in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240826-libya-east-administration-says-closes-oil-fields-over-central-bank-rift (France 24)] [https://www.spglobal.com/commodityinsights/en/market-insights/latest-news/oil/082624-libyas-eastern-government-vows-total-oil-shutdown (S&P Global)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Canada–China relations]]
**[[Canada]] announces a 100% tariff on imports of [[China|Chinese]]-made [[Electric vehicle industry in China|electric vehicles]] and a 25% tariff on Chinese [[steel]] and [[aluminum alloy|aluminum]]. [https://apnews.com/article/canada-china-evs-tariffs-0cd68ba7533bc6e7111cdd5811c8889c (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Nigeria floods]]
**At least 49 people are killed and more than 40,000 people are displaced after heavy rains caused [[flood]]s in [[Adamawa State|Adamawa]], [[Jigawa State|Jigawa]], and [[Taraba State|Taraba]] states, [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/26/floods-in-nigeria-kill-displace-thousands (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Arbaat Dam collapse]]
**The Arbaat Dam collapses near [[Port Sudan]], [[Sudan]], amid floodwaters, killing more than 60 people, displacing around 50,000 more, and destroying 20 villages. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/26/a-dam-collapsed-in-northeast-sudan-killing-four (Al Jazeera)]
*One person is killed and three others are injured in a [[landslide]] in [[Ketchikan]], [[Alaska]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/alaska-ketchikan-landslide-disaster-32e0ee1db2ee45a4af581dcecb017e43 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2024 mpox epidemic]]
**[[Germany]] announces that it will donate 100,000 doses of [[mpox]] vaccines to the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and other [[Africa]]n nations, as well as provide funding to the [[GAVI|GAVI Vaccine Alliance]] through the [[World Health Organization]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/mpox-germany-to-give-africa-100000-doses-of-vaccine/a-70055504 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Russia relations]], [[Arrest of Pavel Durov]]
**[[Russia]]n lawmakers accuse [[France|French]] authorities of arresting [[Russians|Russian-born]] [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] CEO [[Pavel Durov]] in order to acquire confidential information from Telegram users, and urge Russian users to delete all confidential information on the Telegram app. [https://www.politico.eu/article/telegram-ceo-arrest-pavel-durov-russian-military-communications-france/ (Politico)]
**[[President of France]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] makes the first official French acknowledgement of the arrest of Pavel Durov by stating that Durov's arrest had "no political motive" and also dismissed contrary accusations and claims by [[Freedom of speech|free speech]] protesters and Russia as "false information". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/pavel-durov-has-nothing-hide-telegram-says-arrested-founder-2024-08-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Controversies surrounding Uber]]
**The [[Dutch Data Protection Authority]] fines [[Uber]] [[Euro|€]]290 million (US$324 million) for allegedly breaching the [[European Union]]'s [[General Data Protection Regulation]] in order to collect information on its European drivers. [https://www.dw.com/en/dutch-watchdog-fines-uber-over-driver-data-protection/a-70047267 (DW)]
*The [[National Football League Players Association]] files a lawsuit against [[DraftKings]] for allegedly violating an agreement to pay licensing fees on [[National Football League|NFL]] players' [[personality rights|likeness rights]] after DraftKings closed its [[NFT|NFT trading cards]] business. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/nfl-players-union-sues-draftkings-allegedly-breaking-nft-contract-2024-08-26/ (Reuters)]
